left.need: Following the License section's pointer, the reader finds the MIT text in LICENSE, which is not in the repository, so README.md:186-187 tells of a file they cannot open.

The reader meets in the README only what serves deciding and the first run, with fuller use reached from Documentation, while README.md:139-177 still writes fuller use in the README itself, as the user decided, so this needs the user to weigh the item against that decision.

chosen.chosen: The tool's file is at the repository root under the name sort-downloads, so the download URL is https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lovaizu/playground/main/sort-downloads (README.md:122,129) and the changes link is https://github.com/lovaizu/playground/commits/main/sort-downloads (README.md:140).
chosen.why: The download decision leaves the file's path to the architecture stage, yet the install commands need a whole URL; the root with the command's own name is the shortest path a user can copy and matches the name the file is saved under, and the README is made again once the architecture settles the path.

chosen.chosen: The repository's line 'A playground for experimenting and testing — nothing here is meant to last.' stands as the README's first line, above '# sort-downloads', and the old '# playground' heading is dropped.
chosen.why: The README decision keeps the one-line description at the top while the tool's README takes the repository's place; the readme checklist's template has the product name as the one heading, so the line stays and the heading goes.

chosen.chosen: Documentation points to the commit history of the tool's file alone, not the whole repository's commits.
chosen.why: The repository is a playground holding other work, so the file's own history shows only the changes to the tool.
